snippet.title: OpenCNC 3D (Alpha) - Skirmish Test
snippet.description:
8 Player Skirmish Test in Open CNC 3D - The first complete decompile of the N64 version of Command & Conquer, running on the original C&C code, with a full "Enhanced Mode", 8 Player online Multiplayer, Custom Maps and a new map editor. 

Read more on:  www . opencnc3d . com
